test.run: { curl -fsSL --retry 5 --retry-all-errors http://www.iron-spring.com/pli-1.4.1.tgz | tar xz -C /opt && P=/opt/pli-1.4.1 && $P/plic -C -dELF -i$P/lib/include HelloWorld.pli -o hello.o; ld -z muldefs -Bstatic -o hello --oformat=elf32-i386 -melf_i386 -e main hello.o --start-group $P/lib/libprf.a --end-group && ./hello; } || { echo '--- diagnostics'; uname -m; ls -la /opt/pli-1.4.1 2>&1 | head -20; (command -v file >/dev/null && file /opt/pli-1.4.1/* 2>&1 | head -10); exit 1; }
